name: devicefarmz
description: Self-hosted physical device farm for remote Android testing from the browser

scripts.build: npm run build -w @devicefarmz/core && npm run build -w @devicefarmz/server && npm run build -w @devicefarmz/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @devicefarmz/server" "npm run dev -w @devicefarmz/web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:demo -w @devicefarmz/server" "npm run dev -w @devicefarmz/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @devicefarmz/core && npm run typecheck -w @devicefarmz/server && npm run typecheck -w @devicefarmz/web
